company.title: Company
company.subtitle: Printed on every tax invoice. Owner only.
company.readOnly: Only the owner can change the company details.
company.firstSave: The company details have not been saved yet. Fill them in and save to create them.
company.vatHint: A VAT-registered company prints its TRN on every tax invoice.
company.trnHint: 15 digits starting with 100. Required for a VAT-registered company.
company.audited: Every save is written to the audit log with the old and new values.

logo.title: Logo
logo.rules: PNG or JPEG, up to 512 KB · appears on new printouts only.
logo.saveFirst: Save the company details first, then upload the logo.
logo.type: Choose a PNG or JPEG image. Other files (including SVG) are not accepted.
logo.size: The logo is larger than 512 KB. Choose a smaller image.
logo.uploaded: Logo saved. It appears on new printouts.

bank.title: Bank accounts
bank.empty: No bank account yet. Add one to print it on invoices.
bank.note: Choose which account prints in Settings → Print designer. An account is never deleted; a deactivated one stays on invoices already printed with it.
bank.ibanHint: A UAE IBAN: AE and 21 digits. Spaces are fine.
bank.ibanRule: This is not a valid UAE IBAN. Check the digits: AE followed by 21 digits.
bank.swiftRule: A SWIFT code has 8 or 11 letters and digits, like EBILAEAD.
bank.duplicate: This IBAN is already in the list.
bank.deactivateHelp: It will not be offered for new invoices. Invoices already printed with it keep it.

calc.title: Calculation
calc.vatValue: Per line, then the lines are added up
calc.roundingValue: To the fils, no cash rounding
calc.pricesValue: Each item has one price with its own "includes VAT" switch
calc.categories: VAT categories and their rates are in Settings → Lists.

series.title: Document numbering
series.editNote: These can change only until the first number is issued. After that they are fixed for good.
series.prefixHint: Capital letters, digits and -, up to 16, e.g. INV-
series.prefixInvalid: Use 1 to 16 capital letters, digits or -.
series.startInvalid: Write a whole number above zero.
series.preview: The first document will be numbered
series.note: A number is taken only when a document is issued, with no gaps. The next number can never be edited by hand.
series.loadFailed: The numbering series could not be loaded.

periods.title: Accounting periods
periods.reopenNote: Reopening lets postings into this month again. Write why: the reason is kept in the audit log.
periods.lockWarning: Locking {month} is permanent. It can never be reopened, and nothing can ever be added to it or changed in it.
periods.lockCorrections: Lock a month only after its VAT return is filed. Later corrections are made in an open month, with a credit note or a reversing entry.
periods.note: Months are closed and locked in order. A month can be closed only after it ends; nothing can be added to or changed in a closed or locked month.
periods.loadFailed: The accounting periods could not be loaded.

einvoice.title: E-invoicing
einvoice.waiting: Not set — waiting for the accountant
einvoice.note: E-invoices will go through an accredited service provider. The ERP stays the system of record.
